stories.headline: Henderson's Wheel Is Still Wobblin' and the Opener Is Wednesday Night
stories.read: Hold up there, pardner. TreVeyon Henderson ain't practiced since the 24th of August with that busted ankle, and New England kicks off the whole dang season Wednesday night in Seattle. He got on the plane, which is somethin', but the word out of camp is Rhamondre Stevenson takes the first handoff even if the kid suits up, on account of Stevenson bein' the one they trust to keep the quarterback from gettin' trampled. So Henderson is a dry well for Week 1 until somebody says otherwise, and Stevenson is cheap gold sittin' right there on the open range in half the outfits in America. Stake that claim tonight, before the saloon reads the same wire you just did.

stories.headline: Atlanta Hands the Reins to Tua and Sits Penix on the Bench Entirely
stories.read: Well now, the Falcons went and named Tua Tagovailoa their man for Sunday against Pittsburgh, and Michael Penix Jr. ain't even dressin' for it. That knee got cleared but it did not get trusted, plain as day. Here's your read: Tua threw for a hair under thirteen points a game last season, which makes him a low-rent rental horse at best, and the fella throwin' to Drake London and Bijan Robinson matters less than you think when the volume's already there. The real angle is patience. Penix is the higher ceiling once he's ramped up, so if some greenhorn in your outfit panics and dumps him for a bag of beans, you be the one holdin' the beans out.

stories.headline: Nabers Practiced Without the Red Shirt but Won't Promise You Sunday Night
stories.read: Malik Nabers took reps Monday with no non-contact jersey on him, first real sign that knee is trail-ready since he tore it up. Trouble is the man himself won't swear he's playin' against Dallas on the 13th, and the Giants are the cautious sort. Even if he goes, expect 'em to ration how long he's out on the range, so temper how high she can flood in Week 1. Bank a cheap pass-catcher as a one-week rental and hold the line, because a healthy Nabers is a hundred-plus throws comin' his way and you did not pay full freight for him.
